newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian dlr/bonds rise after May economic data.
newsitem.headline: Australian dlr/bonds rise after May economic data.

text.p: The Australian dollar rose and bonds edged higher on news of a 2.9 percent rise in May retail trade and a 2.2 percent rise in May building approvals.

The median forecast for both series had been for a 2.0 percent rise. Forecasts for retail trade ranged from a 0.2 percent fall to a 3.0 percent rise, while approvals forecasts ranged from a 3.0 percent fall to a rise of 10.0 percent.
Shortly after the data came out the Australian dollar was trading at US$0.7538/40 from a pre-data level of US$0.7528/33.
September 10-year futures moved to 92.940, from a level of 92.920 ahead of the data. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373 1800
